app.name: Owly
app.tagline: When they can't say where it hurts

onboarding.title: When they can't say it hurts, behavior is the language.
onboarding.body: Owly helps you record what you see — using the FLACC scale, the same tool nurses use for children who can't self-report pain — and turns weeks of observations into a clear report for the doctor.
onboarding.notdiagnosis: Owly is an observation journal. It does not diagnose. It helps you show a professional what you saw.
points: Validated pain scale (FLACC), individualized to your child
Everything stays on this device — nothing is sent anywhere
onboarding.restoreError: Could not restore that backup file.

child.name: Name (or nickname)
child.communicatesHint: e.g. bangs head, pulls at ear, becomes very still, laughs when hurting
child.title: Your child's profile
child.saveError: Could not save — please try again.

customDescriptors.title: How does {{name}} show pain?
customDescriptors.body: Nurses call this individualized FLACC (rFLACC). Optional: describe the behaviors that are specific to your child for each category — they will appear as hints during observations.
customDescriptors.hint: e.g. pulls left ear, grinds teeth, holds breath

redflags.title: Get help now
redflags.body: Owly is not for emergencies. If any of these are present, stop and call emergency services or go to the ER:
items: Trouble breathing, or lips turning blue
Unresponsive, floppy, or very hard to wake
Stiff neck with fever, or a rash that doesn't fade when pressed
Signs of severe injury or poisoning
A baby under 3 months with fever
You feel something is seriously wrong — trust yourself
redflags.footer: When in doubt, call. You will never regret a call you didn't need.

observe.baselineQ: Is this a painful episode or a calm/baseline moment?
observe.baselineHint: A few baseline observations teach you and the doctor what your child's "normal" looks like.

observe.noteHint: Anything else a doctor should know — e.g. was rocking, refused food, slept 2h

patterns.note: Patterns describe what you recorded — they suggest what to discuss with the doctor, they do not prove cause or treatment effect.
patterns.insightNight: Most episodes happen at night — worth mentioning to the doctor.

patterns.insightZone_one: "{{zone}}" is the most suspected area ({{n}} episode).
patterns.insightZone_other: "{{zone}}" is the most suspected area ({{n}} episodes).

report.title: Doctor report
report.body: A compact summary built for a busy clinician: who your child is, what you observed, patterns, and what you tried.
report.subtitle: Generate a PDF to bring to the appointment.
report.q0: e.g. Could this be an ear infection?
report.q1: e.g. Is the medication plan still right?
includes: How your child usually signals discomfort
Episode timeline with FLACC scores, areas and notes
Patterns: time of day, recurring areas, what helps
report.localNote: Generated entirely on this device — nothing is uploaded.
report.empty: Record at least one pain episode first — the report needs observations.
report.error: Could not generate the PDF — please try again.

pdf.title: PAIN OBSERVATION REPORT
pdf.footer1: Recorded with Owly — a free, open-source observation journal (FLACC: Merkel 1997; individualised rFLACC: Malviya 2006).
pdf.footer2: Observations are caregiver-reported and are not a diagnosis.

report.entryDesc: Pick the period and what to include, then generate the clinician PDF.
report.unsupported: This report can't display the character(s): {{chars}}. Edit or remove them in the journal, or keep the data and export a JSON backup instead — nothing was sent anywhere.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataBody: Everything is stored only in this browser, on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
settings.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes every profile and observation on this device.
settings.pinBody: Require a 4-digit PIN to open Owly. A screen lock only — the journal is not encrypted; anyone with access to this browser's storage can still read it.
settings.pinSaved: PIN saved — Owly is now locked
settings.importError: Couldn't read that file — is it an Owly backup?
settings.demoBody: Load “Léo” — a fictional 9-year-old with 3 weeks of observations, to try every feature instantly.
settings.license: Owly is free and open source (MIT). Observation wording follows the published FLACC scale (Merkel et al., 1997) and rFLACC (Malviya et al., 2006). Owly is an observation journal, not a medical device.
settings.forgotPinWarning: The PIN cannot be recovered — Owly has no reset mechanism. You can erase everything and start over — this deletes all profiles and observations on this device.
settings.importWarn: Replaces all current data on this device.
settings.importPreview: This backup from {{date}} holds {{children}} profile(s) and {{observations}} observation(s). Importing it permanently replaces the {{curChildren}} profile(s) and {{curObs}} observation(s) now on this device.
settings.privacyBody: Everything you record stays on this device (IndexedDB) — no account, no cloud, no analytics. The PIN is only a screen lock: it does not encrypt data, and anyone with access to this device could open the journal with device tools. Backups are unencrypted JSON files: store them like the journal itself. Deleting the app or site data erases everything unless you exported a backup.

face: Occasional grimace or frown, withdrawn, disinterested
Frequent to constant quivering chin, clenched jaw
activity: Lying quietly, normal position, moves easily
Squirming, shifting back and forth, tense
cry: Crying steadily, screams or sobs, frequent complaints
consolability: Reassured by occasional touching, hugging or being talked to; distractible
